intro: Step into Kahramanmaraş Museum, a museum in Kahramanmaraş province, founded in 1947. It gathers the Halaf-period finds of Domuztepe and Neo-Hittite reliefs, and displays the fossil elephants of the region alongside them.
history: Founded in 1947, the museum is the central collection for the region's Halaf-culture excavations. Alongside the finds from Domuztepe, it shows Neo-Hittite reliefs and the fossil elephants recovered from the local beds.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the Halaf pottery, the Neo-Hittite reliefs, the fossil hall and the ethnography section.
facts: Did you know? The fossil elephants show that the Maraş plain was once marsh and savanna — a very different landscape. And the museum is the central collection for the Halaf-period finds of Domuztepe.
outro: This brings our tour of Kahramanmaraş Museum to an end. Please leave the objects untouched and take your photographs without flash. From elephants to potters, this land has many stories; thank you for listening. Enjoy your visit.
